ops: t templates** (#52, added in #56). A request that starts with `/<name>` is replaced by the template of that name, with its arguments filled in (`$1`, `$ARGUMENTS`, `$@`, `${@:N[:L]}`, and `${ARGUMENTS:-default}`). Templates come from the `pi.prompts` of extension packages, from `.pi/prompts` in the repository (only with `trust_project`), and from `<agent_dir>/prompts`. If two templates have the same name, the first one wins.
